perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Authoring explicitly reviews and resolves material ownership, articulation, reach, support, contact, and view conflicts before the first freeze, and again after composition. Generation fidelity remains separately evaluated.

invariants.statement: Preserve requester meaning, intended interaction and body structure; do not replace the desired contact with an easier unrelated pose.
causal_controls: Keep requested deviations grounded in active requester text.

invariants.statement: Pre-core review uses only the conversation and independent reasoning; no case-specific anatomy or candidate catalog supplies initial meaning.

mismatches.source_state: User requested a sulking passenger character; the author added turning and sleeve contact.
mismatches.render_state: User reports an awkward arm. In the single view, the large limb chain is readable but shoulder and wrist articulation are ambiguous; a particular joint violation and complete generation settings are unverified.

hypotheses.statement: Existing literal actuation audits leave material spatial interactions to implicit author reasoning. A required review step with exact version binding can prevent missing or stale review evidence and flagged conflicts from silently proceeding.
hypotheses.falsifier: If missing, unresolved, or stale review records pass the new opt-in pipeline, the structural intervention fails. Even a structural pass does not establish a reduced rendered defect rate.

intervention.general_rule: Review the applicable body mechanism before freezing, repair contradictory authored staging, and require a fresh exact-text review after composition. Derive initial pixel gates without fabricating repair lineage.
intervention.generalization_basis: Generic actor ownership, articulation/reach, support, contact/space, and visibility/projection checks; no fixed body part, limb side, angle, vehicle, costume, or character defaults. Synthetic unrelated human, nonhuman, and inapplicable cases exercise schema behavior only.

package.note: Focused intervention and package checks pass. Overall package qualification is not green: the broad suite is incomplete and has reproduced preexisting failures.

decision.rationale: The structural intervention is implemented and its 20 focused tests pass. All 13 observed failing test methods reproduce before the change. The broad suite is incomplete under high system load, so no whole-suite promotion is claimed.
